For one of the few times in the past dozen years, the Cardinals will open the regular season at home for 2026, hosting the Tampa Bay Rays on Opening Day, March 26, at Busch Stadium, in its 21st season. Their first National League series will be on March 30–April 1 at the New York Mets. The season will end with a September 25–27 weekend at the Milwaukee's American Family Field.
